text: Better than it's competitors.  Stuff is fresh.  Love that they have fresh jalapenos and pickled jalapenos to choose from.  sauces are good.  have the things I like most about qdobe, Moe's, and Chipotle all at 1 spot.  go here.

After all the BBQ I had in Texas and all they hype I heard about BBQ in St Louis. When I walked in, I was impressed. Little place but had awards posted all over. I thought this place was going to be the best of the best but I found it to be average. Dont under estimate, the food was good. I guess I will still have to search for the St Louis hype.
Instagram @planefoodies

Wonderful food, drinks, and service! 

We went to this great place again last night and it reminded us of how much we always enjoy it, and how really terrific the food is - as is everything about this restaurant!  (And it made us wonder why we don't go more often!) They play really great jazz (very listenable) and it always leaves us in a good mood. They carry great craft beers and have inventive, delicious cocktails. We primarily eat a whole food, plant based diet and this place accommodates our needs perfectly while also offering really delicious food. The soft, steaming hot pillows of pita bread make my mouth water just thinking about them.  So many great choices - the baba ganoush is SO good, the falafel fresh and yummy, and the fatoosh full of little delicious surprises.  Try it - you won't be sorry!  We'll be going back ourselves very soon!!!

Reason!!! They never have any grits when I go there and when they did they were so watery and they also put cheese in which made it look horrible it was the worst send it back and the cook said he wasn't cooking anymore with a bad attitude.
This is a great local deli. Everything is fresh and the food is delicious. I especially love breakfast.

It's as amazing as you're being led to believe here.  Watch the Ella Brennan Netflix documentary before you go if you are not familiar.  It truly enhances the whole experience, but even going in ignorant it would have been SO worthwhile.

High quality food and atmosphere. The food was really good and the waiter was helpful with recommendations and answering all our questions. With it being a limited menu, I would recommend looking at the menu before going in as it's not super big.

This is called the "Prime".  It is Lucky Fins take on the French dip, only way better. Picture is after I took one large mouthwatering bite.  Prime rib, cheese sautéed mushrooms and onions. The Ajuice is homemade, I think broth with onions and mushrooms as well. My suggestion, substitute the fries for the garlic fries, amazing!  Food is always amazing, staff is excellent and attentive and very friendly out less fear is outgoing, there's not much you can order it would not be a big hit!

We come here almost every week and love it! Food is good and salsa is amazing! The staff is really friendly to us, and our kids enjoy looking out the windows at the train tracks. The restaurant is clean and service is usually very quick.

I have been dining at Saffron for years. When available, the buffet is always wonderful. They include favorites like tikka masala and curry chicken along with a rotating list of their other dishes and I always find something I love. 

For the full menu, we have had chicken tikka masala (prepared to your specified spice level) which is delicious and full of big chunks of white meat chicken, Navaratan korma (fantastic, not spicy at all), chili chicken (very oily, not a favorite), Hakka noodles (too garlicky but love everything else about it), tandoori chicken (very traditional and done perfectly), and veggie samosas (fantastic, best thing ever and the sauces are amazing). 

The staff are always wonderful, food is always hot and well packed for carry out, and food is prepared when they say it will be. Just a great restaurant all around and I'm so grateful to have it nearby.

Went for football and wings. The waitress was very slow, there where not very many people there, so wondered what took so long, then realized she was out front smoking. Its a shame, because the wings are amazing. I will probably go again, hope I get a better waitress, because the food was really great.

We've been coming here for years and absolutely love it.  We come for the day for spa services and thoroughly enjoy ourselves.  The exercise room and classes are wonderful as is the pools, steam room and sauna.  The food is delicious.
Too much broccoli with my 4shrimps. I will not be getting a meal here no more!! Also ordered beef and broccoli. These people gave me about a pound of straight broccoli.

They serve great margaritas!!!  Their food is the best Mexican around.  The wait time for food is redic!!!   Takes over an hour most nights to get your food order.   

This place has so much potential.  Staff is not the friendliest .... maybe bc they are in the heart of tourist area.... but lots of us locals are here at least once a week.

I always get the "Thin Mint" latte here. I like it. Heard the barista talking about it to the cashier and they said it tastes like a stale poptart. Couldn't even drink it after that. All I could taste was stale poptart. Wasted $5. Thanks a lot. Wish I could take my tip back.

Oh and their sandwiches are overpriced and skimpy.

Not the first time I've gone there half an hour before they close, there are lots of people going in and their grill is off, seems to have been for a while and they're out of things. Why don't you stay open until you're supposed to close??

Talk about yum! The flavor is great and everything I put into my bowl was delicious. Great service and I like that they give you a menu to fill out so you don't have to stand and tell them what you want in your bowl. Will eat here again.
Really food service from the bar side. Even though a new cook in the back the pizza is always very good! Being a native of Chicago pizza I can attest this hits the spot! :)

Place is great. Queso is bomb. Service is impeccable. Atmosphere is awesome. Saint Anejo was my normal go to place but Superica is giving it a run for it's money. Definitely worth checking out if you're in the Gulch area.
I love this place! The food is great and the staff is so nice every time we come here! This definitely a place to take people when they visit the Tampa area if they love food pizza!
Some of the most authentic Mexican food in the Treasure Valley. Wonderful service and congenial staff. A must!

First visit for lunch. Egg salad on a croissant. Delish! Very large. Got a mini quiche for dinner. Great. But you need to see the bakery cases!!
 Cupcakes, cookies, brownies,
What's not to love. Authenticity decorated. Classic dishes that taste good. Not too pricy. Friendly staff. If you haven't already, give it a try.

We are trying to support restaurants during the virus. We haven't done carry out with Buca and we will definitely do it again. I forgot how large the portions are. They were quick to remind us about sizes, made us garlic mashed potatoes even though it wasn't in their modified menu and added extra bread. The food was delicious and there was plenty for leftovers. Delicious.

We popped into this place because the other restaurant we were planning to go to had a two hour wait. Overall pretty much what you would expect, although the craft beers were a bit expensive for a pub vibe... I figured I could've got a three or four dollar draft but they didn't have anything in that range. The taco salad was decent, made with homemade ranch, but otherwise it was still the typical bar food menu. Nothing wildly out of the ordinary and no use of higher quality ingredients, interior finishing or added elements of experience. I would recommend if you just want a chill vibe or quick service. They did a good job with service.

Waiters so nice and they have a delicious gelato. Right now they have a lot of out door dinning options and delicious food! Waiters and waitresses wear face coverings everything is cleaned. Only down side is that people on the street walking by don't always wear their masks.

Where the hell can you find a KFC buffet anymore?

That's right you can't. For $8 and some change you won't find anything like this. 

Food quality can vary at times but overall I haven't had a bad experience when you take everything into consideration. 

I'd rather continue supporting this location so that it may continue running because it is awesome

I usually get chicken pad thai when trying out a new Thai place to gauge my future interest. That served here is well constructed with ample chicken and a very tasty sauce; the medium heat level met my expectations and I have become a regular customer for this dish. The service crew is pleasant and attentive and the atmosphere good for the strip mall location.

We went here for a date night and had a wonderful time! We got the Antipasta Plate for appetizer (super yummy with toasted bread, 3 meats, 2 cheeses, a small salad and artichoke hearts), i ordered the black and blue gnocchi (really creamy potato gnocchi with tender sirloin on top!!!), and my boyfriend ordered the pork chop milanese (the pork chop was HUGE and he got the polenta (GET THIS NOT THE POTATOES!!!). we were tempted for dessert but were too full! The staff was amazingly nice, the covid restrictions strict and the restaurant very romantic.  Stop by for sure!

Wow, probably best falafel I've had.. granted I haven't had a lot and I'm far from a vegan/vegetarian.. But even my carnivorous ass was loving my large spicy falafel whole wheat pita with nicely seasoned fries.. It filled me right on up. Also appreciated the veggie bar to garnish your meal. The platters looked bomb as well.

This place is small and CASH ONLY. It can be difficult to move around in here and the chairs are kinda creaky. Be prepared to wait in a decent length line at lunch. But other than that it's a great option.

First time here - absolutely fantastic. Food was outstanding, sangria was delicious. First off the appetizers ... stuffed long hots and the ricotta board. Both were phenomenal and Ive never had ricotta and honey before and it was just such a delightful mixture and was amazing with the homemade bread. My fiancées entree was a great pasta in creamy red sauce with lump crab meat, shrimp and scallops. My entree was a perfectly cooked strip steak covered in a mozzarella cheese on a bed of mashed potatoes and broccoli rabe. Zero complaints on food. The service was also perfectly okay, not too on top of you and allowed you to enjoy the food. Setting is also very comfortable and open. They also offer free parking in a garage nearby with entree purchase which in Philly is huge. Will certainly be back to try more of the menu! Great first experience.

One of the best places I've eaten in quite some time. Friendly staff. Clean. Huge portions for foodies like me. Not to mention literally everything on the menu sounded amazing. I had the Memphis 'Chos and my wife had the Cancun Quesadilla, highly recommended by the staff, and both were incredible! Definitely will be returning!

This place has gone through different ownership and I been there for most.  I have to say though, Hector the new owner: awesome, friendly and DAMN good cook.  Very funny and likable guy.  Have a craving for something specific?  Just let him know he will make it, no if, buts about it.  Californian Surf & Turf, my pregnant wife said it was "THE best she ever had" (picky eater, wink).  
If you try it, it sure will be your favorite.  The prices are lower than most Mexican joint that don't even taste as good as this one.

The most authentic Indonesian food. It's a small corner eatery on Moore and Hicks street with tight seating area. You will see a lot of Indonesian theme decorations. 

It's a cafeteria style food where the foo is already cooked except the satay. You place the order on the cute hawker cart. The menu is posted on the food counter on the left, more menu listing is on the wall to the right. For to-go food there are options based on the size of the container.

Gudeg: stewed jack fruit. The flavor is perfect and balanced. Jack fruit is tender but not mushy.

Lodeh: mixed stewed veggies. Also has perfect flavor and refreshing from the fresh veggies.

Gado gado: big portion with steamed veggies and rice cakes with fritters on top. The best part is in the amazing peanut sauce.

Chicken satay; big chunks of tender chicken and not over charred . The peanut sauce is amazing.

All of the dishes remind me home.

My criticism here is I don't think staff record the order when I told her what I wanted so you're at the mercy of her memory. You pay when the food is ready. I had to double check my order which turned out to be incorrect.

Also most of the container is styrofoam. I wish it's more environmentally friendly.

I just ate here a with a coworker and the service was great. I think they must train all of their servers in the South. Because they're always extremely pleasant and overly friendly and familiar. Like your favorite Auntie.  It's hard to mess up eggs and pancakes, so the food is always good but what I really enjoy is the "down-home" service.

Great Friday night burger spot! We are big fans of the cool springs store and were so excited they were opening up this location in Franklin. Daniel and Jordan and crew were friendly, fast and served up the burger and fries we have come to know and love. They had a veggie burger and a catfish Poboy on the special board and we considered those for half a second - but neither of us wanted to bypass the burgers! Hands down best burger in Franklin.

The food and service was excellent! My wife's salad was outstanding and my pot pie was to die for! There were four others in our party and everyone was very please with the food and service, except for the person who had the street tacos who said they were pretty mediocre.

This place was disappointing. Stopped by after a nail appointment with my mom on Mother's Day around 3:15. The place wasn't busy, so we got sat quickly. We waited about 15 minutes until I asked the host if we had a server. She came and brought us our drinks and took our order. We didn't see her again until our food came out. The restaurant was not busy at all, yet there were multiple tables that needed to be cleaned off. Cleaning supplies and trash stayed on the tables for the duration out of meal which was a bummer. Only one server looked like she was enjoying herself, the rest looked like they had been held against their will to be here. We waited 35 minutes for two rolls, I got impatient so I got up to find our server and the curtain to the kitchen was open and a server was getting a massage by a male employee. The sushi was good but the experience makes never want to come back.

The chicken here compared to other Raising Cane's stores was questionable. They were much smaller, and less tasty -- unsure if it's the company's cause, but they were a bit lacking. The service here is alright, though.
My 10 piece Garlic Parmesan Classic Wings were Awesome  a 10 on the scale of 1-10. Our Nursing Crew Will Definitely Be Ordering Some More.

Really glad we made here. We were a group of 8, so there was as much sharing. :) I don't remember the exact names of all the things, but I had a dish with shrimp, crab, and artichoke hearts that was really good. There was a little too much crab shell left in I thought. I also really loved the turtle soup. My wife had shrimp sautéed with butter and wine, and it was amazing. Plenty of sauce left over to dunk the bread in, which you definitely want to do. Others in our group really loved many levthe duck, shrimp etouffe, gumbo... You get the idea. I thought some of the service was a little haphazard, and they have a policy where men have to wear jackets. Did not seem like that was consistently enforced though... Overall, we enjoyed our meal there, and would recommend you give it a try.

The server was so nice & the drinks were good! But I have to give 2 stars because that bartender was inattentive and rude. He made my friend and I feel unwelcome & I don't think I'll ever come back because that's not okay to be treated that way, especially when I'm paying $15/drink

I've been here a few times and all I can say is ... everything on the menu that I've tasted (chicken, chicken wings, burgers, fries, shakes) are absolutely incredible! Flamme Burger is family owned and they don't have a freezer in the restaurant so all of their food is FRESH af. The service we always have is also incredible, the staff are super friendly and give you a good background of the place, it's great. My gf asked me what negative thing I would say in my review, because I always at least try to bring out one negative thing, but I don't have one to give this time! Not a date night kinda place but definitely grab your next lunch here

This is the absolute worst IHOP I have ever been to. The service is horrible, this particular location has been going downhill for awhile now. I was seated and it took 15 minutes for the waitress to even come out of back and when she did she acknowledged the people that were seated for 10 minutes after we were. Still not acknowledging me and my husband, went to put that party's full order in. By this time we still haven't even ordered drinks, when we did order I was told when she brought my husbands tea out that there was no lemonade so I need to choose something else because she can't go back there and make it because she has tables to wait on. Granted there were only about 6 tables occupied including mine. That was the last straw, I then said that's okay we are leaving. Only then did she try to get the manager to make some lemonade, but that wasn't enough for me. I told her I was leaving and I meant it, I am not about to spend my money in an establishment that doesn't treat me with respect. I will NEVER come here again.

Good food...light and airy ambiance. 

Appetizers, cocktail, shared bottle of wine about $150. 

Service was good...didn't interfere to much. 

Grilled chicken wings were fantastic.

My family and I eat here every year for Mother's Day! We couldn't pass up brunch even though we would have to eat at home! We got the pate and charcuterie board (which is pictured) that we put together ourself from the to-go box! Also got a crawfish quiche- a little over cooked, but great flavor, a quiche degas, omelet, soft shell crab salad, and the hanger steak! All phenomenal! Perfect please to support local and have a great tasting brunch! #corona #covid19 #neworleans #brunch #mothersday

Ten Asian Food Hall has both bb.q Chicken and Poke-Man. I have tried their fried chicken and it tastes the same like the bb.q Chicken in Upper Darby, PA. So if you order the fried chicken, there will be a wait so it may be best to order ahead of time and do pick-up. I tried the Dancing Eel and Salmon Shiso poke bowl. Both were great, although the Salmon Shiso poke bowl had more sauce than I would like, but that's minor. My favorite drink is the Bubble Milk Black Tea with Handmade Brown Sugar. Be sure to wait a few minutes before drinking so that the outside coating can mix in with the milk.  

4.5/5
The spring rolls and ph combo hit the spot.  The purest will probably complain about the lack of beef tripe but I'm totally ok without it.  Solid all around!

I've been on the fence on whether this establishment deserved three or four stars.  I'm going with four based on there really wasn't anything bad about my experience. 

You order from the counter and your food is brought to you at the table.  I liked that the drink station was clean and there were all the necessary condiments to include soy and chili sauce. 

I chose the general tsao's chicken with a bit of spice.  The main dish was just ok.  I enjoyed the chicken but not the rice or veggies.  Just seemed cheap quality.  With that being said I really liked the hot and sour soup and cream cheese wontons.  The wontons tasted a bit crabby but I would still order again.  For a quick lunch I do think this is a decent option.
Disregard any negative reviews based on my experience. Everyone was very friendly, some English speaking employees, great food and great price! Definitely a place to bookmark!

We stopped here for a quick lunch as we were headed to Branson, Mo.  I had found all the excellent reviews on Yelp so decided to give it a try.  The restaurant is not fancy; just a small family business.  They were so busy so we knew we must have found a jewel thanks to Yelp. 

We were not disappointed!  The gyros were fresh and delicious!   There were other traditional Greek items on the menu that I would like to try.  When passing through St. Louis again I would definitely stop.  The affordable prices make it a great stop for families.  There were a few menu items for those wanting a more traditional plate like hamburgers and hotdogs.

Another amazing dinner!! Came last weekend with my fiancé and back again tonight with my dad and sister.

We ordered the same appetizers.. takoyaki, fried oysters, and waffle fries with yum yum sauce. These are the must get items - sounds basic but it's so good.

This time for entrees, we got 3 lbs of head on shrimps, 1 lb of the king crab legs, and half dozen blue crabs all in garlic butter sauce. Everything was great!! Garlic butter is the way to go~
We were visiting Philly for a weekend. This place came highly recommended. Food was delicious and service was great!

Have been twice to this location while visiting New Orleans. First time had gumbo and catfish. Which were good though portions small. Second time had buffalo chicken wings which didnt taste like buffalo, but were crisp on outside and tender on outside and tasty. Had two drinks and no buzz...soooooo I'd say drinks weren't strong. Band there was awesome, Chucky and Friends...saw them first time and they were why I came back and time. All in all a good spot but if I go again I'm getting shots, no mixed drinks!

We had gotten wings at work, they was very good therefore I had to go the next day and get some more. I looked online and the price for 50 wings was $36 and some change, get there and 50 wings was def not that price. They simply was $1 a wing. No matter if you get 1 or 250. The guy behind the counter is def strange. Has a very dry sense of humor and almost robotic. His opening line is how can I make your day better as if he is tired of saying it. Either way, the wings I've had are great. I'd like to come back, but perhaps I will get a bit more of a guarantee on the prices before I return.

Great restaurant for Sunday brunch or a holiday brunch, as was today, on Labor Day.  Excellent service thank you Mary. Had biscuits and gravy eggs and a hot cup of coffee bottomless of course. The biscuits were tender fresh out of the oven, not hard tack, like most places.

I have one place that I really enjoy the sushi and stick with what I know, but this place wow. The sushi was delicious. I will definitely be making my way to come here again. I got the shrimp tempura roll and spicy crab roll and it was delicious! So happy I came and tried. I came back multiple times after my first time. My ultimate favorite roll is the sappro roll! It's delicious!

Perfect ambiance, great food ,good service! Pia's is in the original Gulfport Library building. A cosy , and comfortable vibe ,perfectly lit by candelabras inside and out .  Delicately balanced flavors, and textures . The bruschetta was fresh and generous. Fresh , light pasta , that had the perfect amount of sun dried  tomato! Great desserts! Server missed the mark slightly on his description of a few items , but was very attentive. Took awhile for entrees to arrive, but totally worth the wait. I could have sat there all night. One of my favorite dining experiences, ever!

Wonderful setting.
The ambiance is nice and relaxing. Decor is upscale to a point. 
We experienced a few challenges...
Sometimes it's not the problem but how management resolves the issue.
The management is superior!!!!
Cassandra has superior skills. She is an asset to the restaurant.
This place had phenomenal food with some of the best drinks I've had. If you're ever in St. Louis I would try this place out

Found this restaurant on yelp after leaving a chain restaurant that had an hour wait... since it had great reviews, we decided to check it out!!

The location and exterior aren't anything special but don't let that deter you!  Once inside, the smell of yummy food, the greeting by the staff and the great prices made me happy we didn't wait at the chain restaurant  

We ordered two 1/2 lb non-stuffed burgers, a shredded chicken sandwich, sweet potato fries and onion rings.  The food came out quick and hot.  

The burgers were very big and looked great!  My son couldn't finish his because it was so big but he said it tasted good.  The onion rings and sweet potato fries were excellent!  The chicken sandwich was huge and overflowing with shredded chicken.  It had good flavor but was way too much for me.  I would try the other chicken sandwich if we visited again.  

Restaurant interior was clean (including the restrooms) very roomie so you can spread out. 

Very pleasant experience... would definitely recommend it and will visit it again!!

Randomly wondered into this place when I was in the area, and I'm sure glad I did. I ordered the Italian Diablo, and it was one of, if not the best hoagie, I've ever had. The roll was a perfect balance between hard and soft, and they even scoop out some of the breading so they can load up the hoagie with meat. The hoagie itself was packed with soppressata, ham and cheese. Took a bit long to make since I was there during lunch, so I recommend ordering ahead. Will definitely be back. The old school marketplace vibe was pretty cool as well.

Damn good. Enough said.  the lines wrapped around the building don't lie. If you're looking for something for yourself the donut holes are great. If you so happen to want to share those donuts with others the glazed dozen is sufficient. I would even dare to say these donuts are better than Longs, Titus, and Jacks.
Stopped by this BW three While in Nashville visiting and seeing all the attractions today had down here. We had a good time stopping here for some quick beer and chicken wings everything is solid

The food was awesome and the staff was amazing! They were so friendly, kind and went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. I honestly can't say enough good things about them. During this Covid pandemic they did a wonderful job wearing their masks, keeping social distancing in-place and making sure everything was clean. A+ to them!

Had two sushi rolls and both reminded me of something you'd get pre packaged at a grocery store. The rice is the tell - texture is wrong. Way gummy. Fish was in sparing amounts and mediocre. That was the good part. My wife had pad Thai and it was downright awful. Easily the worst I've ever tasted. It had the taste of dirty (even rancid) oil - like the grill or pan wasn't clean. And I'm not talking something slight, this was unpleasant and strong. We live on treasure island and want this to be good but it just isn't.
As usual great pies and survive. Best crust around ! Spite sweet taste to their sause
I rarely give a five. Imho, best dimsum in Delaware county. Served hot to the table, no steam carts. Happy eastern new year.

This restaurant is quite amazing The inside of the building is small but fine. The staff are friendly and their service is excellent. The food is delicious and their selection is big with many meals and ice creams. The service is also fast when you order your food.

They need to stop referring to themselves as authentic. 

I was raised in south Texas and am of Mexican descent, this meal was sooooo bad, I was personally offended.

Serving popcorn instead of chips and salsa should have been enough of a red flag...

There is nothing authentic about putting iceberg lettuce and cherry tomatoes on top of your enchiladas. 

The side of bland white rice was the final straw. Where was the red Spanish rice? That's Mexican restaurant 101...
Amazing food, great service, family-friendly and reasonably priced! I'm just sorry we haven't stopped in sooner. Will be back for sure.

Came here twice. First time was a random Saturday and evidently they were closed. Slightly frustrating that they don't have a website or even someone in charge of posting on Yelp that they're temporarily closed. 

When we returned when they were open, we ordered brisket, pork belly, ribs, potato salad, and Mac n cheese. The fatty pieces of brisket were ah-MAY-zing!! Very reminiscent of the bbq we used to get in Texas. I would've liked to see similar options here as well, the ability to order extra moist (fatty), moist (semi-fatty), and lean, instead of whatever is available. Pork belly is limited, and we were one of the last people able to order it around noon on a Saturday. It was superb, definitely worth a try if you love an uber-crunchy texture. The ribs were a tad dry for us, not fall-off-the-bone tender or particularly juicy. Same goes for the Mac n cheese. The potato salad was surprisingly good, not overpowered by the taste of mayo or celery. All in all, a very solid bbq joint that we will be returning to. 

Don't be deterred by the crowd; they turn over orders quickly and the free beer while you wait is a very nice touch. Street parking wasn't too hard for us to find just around the corner from the restaurant.

A small hole in the wall restaurant, owned and operated by a Turkish couple, the owner was very nice and he took the time to chat with us despite him being busy. Traditional Turkish food, the meat pies were amazing, very crisp, light and fresh. The hummus is also a must try, it s served with a basket of hot bread. The lemon mint drink is a very refreshing, that I also highly recommend. The mixed grill platter served on a yummy bed of rice is also great.

Pretty yummy food, unfortunately, they've "messed up" orders on a number of occasions (thankfully I'm not picky). It's more of an annoyance than anything else- they have forgotten the avocado, used brown rice when I specified I wanted white, left out a dish in a large to-go order, etc. Another annoyance is that the service can be slow. All that being said, I'd still give this 4 stars because they have healthy and decent food and the COOKIES  omg.. the cookies are delicious (despite being vegan haha)!

Hopefully Laughing Planet can work on faster service & the details, then it would be a 5 star restaurant. I'll still visit occasionally but I'm hopeful that it can become more of a regular spot for me.

We came here for the Szechuan food we had heard good things about. 

Know ahead of time that they will only let you pay with two credit cards per table. This is really annoying, but be prepared to Venmo. 

We shared everything. We started with scallion pancakes, Dan Dan Noodles, and wontons in chili oil. The wontons were probably my favorite of the group. 

For entrees we got Mapo Tofu, Garlic Style Pork, Crispy Rice Style Fish, Dry Pepper Style Chicken, and Dry Pot Style Beef. My favorite styles were Dry Pepper and Crispy Rice followed closely by Garlic Style. 

The only thing I wasn't a fan of was the Mapo Tofu. It was a lot runnier than other versions I've had and the Tofu was mushier. 

I was surprised that nothing was very spicy. Even the things marked as a 10 on the menu weren't very spicy. This is definitely in contrast to other Szechuan food I've had.

The service wasn't great. You really have to flag down the waiters to get them to pay attention and take your order. 

Overall we got a lot of food for a good price and we enjoyed it. I would come back, but it's not ideal for groups because of the payment restrictions.

The burgers we tried were perfect! The servers were very nice & the atmosphere was great as well. Prices and portions were fair. I personally wasn't a fan of the corn beef egg rolls but we will return & try some other menu items.

Homely atmosphere. The food is a tad bland for my liking (and unlike traditional Korean food) I could sense they wanted to lower the sodium level overall for a healthier diet. Nonetheless, this is the place to go if you want Korean street food!! Staff is really friendly and they make you feel welcome.
The food was good, but kind of expensive for the bento box and eel don. I LOVED the Tempura, but there was no dipping sauce for it. The ginger dressing for the salad was veeery good.

I've never stopped multiple times during a meal and asked my husband "how did they make this the best tasting thing ever?" Lou made me do that, and I'm not one bit upset about it. Truly the best brunch I've had in this city by far. The complexity of flavor yet simple approachability of each dish was brilliant! We had the street corn, crispy potatoes, and eggs, fennel bacon, and toast. Every single item was absolutely perfect, and the patio ambience was magic. All was made even more special thanks to our server Hugh. He was the perfect balance of knowledgeable, kind, and attentive. We cannot wait to return again and again, and we love having this special place right down the street from our home!
Was really hungry after a day of work but the hotpot is very filling and i like it a lot. Compared to many hotpots i have had, this is one of the better ones.

*This review is for the spa*

Working retail really sucks the life outta you! After holiday season and working 2! Not 1 BUT 2! 50 hr work weeks back to back, I told myself that I deserved a treat! And what better way to treat yourself than with a spa day!

Spa: 
Every inch of the spa was clean and very modern. Once you've checked in, The girl from the front desk gives you a tour of the whole spa, which is helpful! They have a relaxation room (tea and water is provided) Sauna, Steam room, Gym and a pool. They give you a locker ( more spacious than I expected) and you can make up your own 4 digit code which is nice! The robes are very warm and plush. They also give you slides which came in handy since I forgot to pack some for the pool.
The women locker room is very nice, they provide you with everything you need! Hairdryer, brush, comb, deodorant, razors, you literally just have to bring yourself and a bathing suit.

*Also, This is my first real spa experience. I usually go to Hand and Stone for a massage, which I never really enjoyed but w/e it did the job. Why pay $150 for H&S when you can pay the same price for a more relaxing and luxurious experience.*

General Service: All the staff members I encountered were very nice and accommodating.

Atmosphere: It felt very luxurious, staff and guests were all very quiet which I appreciated. The Relaxation room was my favorite part! The lighting was perfect and there was enough space for multiple people to really relax and stretch o

We tried Chihuahuas for the first time after a coworker recommended it. I will definitely go back. The food is amazing, the service is very good. Definitely the best Mexican food in the Reno area as far as I'm concerned.

The food is absolutely delicious. Great atmosphere, awesome staff and the CHEF ..... AMAZING !!  My MOFONGO with Fried Chicken chunks was absolutely delicious.  Very tasty and the MOFONGO WAS TASTY and MOIST!!  Highly recommend!!!!

I'm so glad I found this place and have a great spot to take visitors for an elevated dining option. I've been a couple of times and have enjoyed every visit. It is on the safer side to make a reservation on their website which uses Resy. I haven't had any issues finding a table for my group size at the time we wanted to go. I recently went without a reservation and was able to get a seat at one of the bar areas. This wasn't too ideal for my party of 3 but it informed the other time I went to make a reservation. Menus are used via QR code. Both times I got the tacos and loved them. Their drinks are also delicious and strong. The atmosphere is chill yet sophisticated. I can't wait to see what other concepts The Hall comes up with!

Fried Shrimp po boy was decent and flavor was so so. I was expecting more of a bang, however, i received a fiss. I literally had this because it is a Nola staple. But i won't go back only because it was not mind blowing, it was just decent as a dish.

This is one of the better barbecue places in Sparks if you're there stop by there's a lot of great food and the service is fantastic, the owner Jay is great, Kristyn is awesome and is a great waitress.
We will definitely go back
No stars! Marty regularly asks families with kids to leave if they make a peep, he is rude, makes up lies to justify his behavior. Pizza is subpar and inconsistent, won't be back!

I recently ordered takeout- a family sized meal to last a few days. I ordered the chicken tinga tacos, which came with rice, choice of beans, pico de gallos, chips, salsa, sour cream, cabbage, and tortillas. I also ordered the flan. I was very satisfied. Support local business!

Ok don't know where to start..... seafood tower is a must!   Lobster, shrimp, oysters, crab, shooters, sauces, etc!    Could be a great meal with a couple glasses of wine or an Appetizer to share!  Tamale in a lobster..... yes a taste to remember!    A must try!    Seafood enchiladas again gives you the best of Sonora and the ocean!    Seating can be tight so make sure you grab a reservation, regardless of day!    Patio is a great date place!    Another Flores winner!!!!!

Just went there twice in 2months and they still forget my stuff. Always end up forgetting stuff and over paying. I was thinking it's just an accident but it's continue to happen. Remember to look to see if you got your order if they're to (high) to even notice.

We went fishing and heard this place was the place to have your catches cooked. We brought some barracuda that we caught and had them fried and blackened.

The fish was amazing and the way they executed the fish for us, we can't complain. We got to sit up top when the sunset was coming down, amazing view and good food, can't ask for more.

We ordered additional dishes, the chicken pasta was alright, alligator bites were different but we loved it. Sweet potato fries were good, and the clam chowder I heard was decent.

Highly recommend this place!!

Went there for lunch.  Our waiter did a fantastic job explaining the menu.  Our food arrived quickly and steaming hot.  I chose the house seasoning for my boil -- great suggestion.  The portions was large.  Cannot wait to be back in town to stop on again!

Pretty good Pho. Very tasty and they do a great job at carry out. I've had problems before with carry out Pho but they did a great job. Spring rolls very fresh. Pleasant staff. Will be my go to Pho place

I'm not an expert on Sushi rolls. This place has awesome specialty sushi rolls. We ordered three specialty sushi rolls: Volcano, Captain, and the James Bond roll were all awesome rolls. 

We also ordered some meals: Green Curry, Chicken pad Thai, and spring rolls for appetizers. Every thing was awesome but definitely prefer the sushi rolls. 

The only thing I did not care for were the boba in the Thai tea. Not as jelly soft as I usually like it. Drink was awesome just not the boba. 

Everyone who worked here were all awesome and friendly. They gave us some complimentary cupcakes and candies for the kids. Thanks again! Drift belt be back for the rolls.

This place is going down hill fast.  Took the waiter 10 minutes to greet us. The bathrooms are disgusting. No paper towels and the place stinks. 
Over 30 minutes to get food and the place is practically empty. It's now been 40+ minutes and we're out of here. Off to Bubba's !

this place hit the spot for late night munchies. nice attempt on beef noodle soup and fried chicken; i would rate both at a cool 3/5; not bad yet definitely not something i will think about in the future.
very popular place to pre-game (BYOB) and have snacks before your night out. spacious interiors and super friendly servers. this place has something for everyone.

A great French addition to Haddonfield's BYOB scene. The escargot in a tasty persillade sauce was a wonderful way to start things off. The skate wing and the chicken were both excellently prepared, and the roasted carrots topped with a pistachio aillade was a great accompaniment, with a serving size plenty for two. Finished with a plate of excellently selected cheeses. The menu is small, but has a wide range of dishes. The restaurant itself is also small but comfortable, with nice spacing between the tables despite the limited space. Only complaint would be that on a warm night it can get a little stuffy (thought they are working on this) and that noise levels can make it a little difficult to converse. Service is very friendly and professional, as you'd expect  from the owners of the also excellent (but slightly fancier) Two Fish, located nearly across the street. Limited seating and its certain popularity will make finding a table difficult, but its definitely worth fitting it into your schedule. I know I'll be back to explore the rest of the menu.

In comparison to my other Chick Fil A experiences, this one is mediocre. Long waits during lunch hour in both drive through and dining room. Are they using the same tactics as other franchise locations ie Brentwood? Customer service is bland and I don't always hear "my pleasure." Raise the bar! It's in the name.
Best indian food in sparks. consistently fresh with wonderful spices, decent potions and the rice deliciously aromatic.!

I went to The Cheesecake Factory with my hubby and got the usual!! Fettuccine Alfredo. Delicious! My hubby got chicken costoletta!! And we had the sweetest most helpful waitress Keira! She we never had an empty glass! AMAZING service. The food is always great but Keira really made our date night enjoyable with her great service.

I got an order of these with my pizza (review over on the Pizza Beeria) page. This was my second time and I got cookies + cream and maple + bacon options (don't remember the actual names). They were so good! Even after I ate 1/2 my pizza they were stills soft + gooey - just how I love my cinnamon rolls. I cut each in half and enjoyed a little of both, then warmed them up with the rest of the pizza for another meal, and still just as good!

Wonderful place for lunch and dinner! Great environment. And good vibes. This place reminds me of a smaller version of Chelsea Market in newyork except it's less bougie. Though overall there's a great selection of food and the drinks at the bar are very creative tastey. It was crowded at lunch, but it only took me a few minutes before I was able to find a table for my party.

Just recently moved to the area and I'm sure glad we gave Ron's a try. It's a clean cozy neighborhood bar and restaurant. When we first checked out their menu we were nervous because it was huge. Me and my wife thought this has to be mainly frozen reheated food. Boy were we wrong. Our waiter informed us everything is freshly made in house. They weren't lying. We have been here 3 times in the past month and everything we have tried is 5 stars. So far my favorite is the hand carved roast beef. I would highly recommend this restaurant!

We went for brunch today and what an absolute mess. To start, we were sat down at a filthy table and had to ask the waiter to wipe it down. I'm not even being picky about a stray water ring here and there, but we're talking covered in crumbs and schemers of jelly and crusty goo. The water glasses smelled like dirty water. It then took someone 10 minutes to take our drink order, even though there were maybe 6 tables sat in the large front bar section. Our party of 4 ordered our food at 1:30p, and the waiter noted the kitchen was a bit backed up. No problem, we said. We had a guest who needed to leave by 2:15, so we asked if backed up meant she'd still be able to order and get food before needing to leave. He assured us that would happen. I've been to plenty of brunch places in similar situations, and usually simply keeping the drinks flowing and communicating status keeps us happy as clams. This was not the case here. After ordering, we were maybe checked on a total of 3 times over the next hour, even as empty glasses were very apparent on the table. And when we were checked on it was because we had to flag down a server to get a refill - especially on the bottomless drinks that were of course on a timer to end at 2pm. 2:15 came and went with still no food or acknowledgement of the continued wait, so our one companion had to simply cancel her food order and leave for her previously disclosed appointment. The rest of us waited another 20 minutes without being checked on or refi

Have to update my review as this place has become a staple for me.  The curry is the best around and downright addictive.  The pad thai uses quality, fresh ingredients and is also the best in the area.  Ample portions for the price and love the fact it's a byo.  The servers are over the top friendly.
Super deluxe melt on a Galaxy Bagel. Same order for 10+ years! The bagels aren't like NY bagels, it's more about the toppings.

There now, lots of staff , no wait, happy servers and bartenders , coco shrimp with choice of sauces, very good, jessie is a great bartendet, place is clean the kitchen staff rocks!!! Saw the barbecue shrimp past go by , looks amazing...kudos to the chefs!! Great experience....

We went to Eddie V's on 10/5 for my boyfriends birthday. We had never been before and did not know what to expect. I don't eat fish or seafood but my boyfriend does. There was plenty of options for me to choose from. 
Our waiter was so kind and so knowledgeable on the menu. We started our meal with drinks. My boyfriend got the hope diamond and I got the 24 Karat and wow were they good! The complimentary bread and butter was so delicious and the paprika salt on the butter was a nice touch. My boyfriend ordered two oysters and loved them. For our entrees we both ordered the 12oz. Filet cooked medium, I got the horseradish parm crust, and he added brown butter scallops. The food came out quickly and WOW was that first bite heavenly. The filet just melts in your mouth and the crust was just the perfect touch. We also ordered the cheddar potatoes au gratin and the truffle Mac. Both were AMAZING but that cheddar au gratin made me speechless! 
They brought out a small piece of bananas foster for my boyfriends birthday and that was also so good. 
It's pricey but SO worth it. We were so impressed with all of the food we had there and will definitely return.

Tasted like a greasy fast food burger.  5 Guys greasy nasty ass tastes better than this place.

HUGE disappointment as my husband was so happy they came to our city.......

Went for their homemade pastrami. We had calamari as an appetizer with a cornmeal coating with arugula roasted corn. Best in Tucson. My wife had the veggie lasagna also great. We split a ceasar salad with roasted tomatoes nice slivers of Romano cheese, also very good. But the homemade pastrami proves whoever made it does not even know the right  cut of meat to use for pastrami. If you are over sixty, or grew up in NY or any other good size city or lived near a Jewish neighborhood you know what real pastrami looks and taste like. At the Hub their pastrami is made from round or a cross cut piece of beef. The pastrami was dry and tasteless. The bread, supposedly rye was thick cut and dry. The owners of the Hub should go to Beyond Bread and purchase a real loaf of seeded rye bread and go to Chompie's in Phoenix to eat a real pastrami sandwich. So do not be fooled like we were expecting real  good homemade pastrami on real rye bread.

I ordered the jumbo shrimp platter and they brought me popcorn shrimp. The waiter took it back after I addressed the issue. My husband finished his meal and they brought me my order The jumbo shrimp ,they charge 17.00 ,where medium shrimp. I complained and told the waiter they should be embarrassed to serve this . The manager never came to my table . We will never go back. They are not dealing with tourist and they are trying to play a fast one on the locals.Locals beware.

Super good sushi rolls and appetizers to choose from for all you can eat. Didn't take as long as I thought to get our tables order of sushi considering we were a pretty big group. I'm always worried of that at any sushi place but they didn't disappoint. I recommend the baked mussels and the "this is how we roll" long roll!

Great food for quite reasonable prices. Always friendly and courteous.  Delivery drivers always super nice. I love that in the dining area you can see into the kitchen. It is neat, tidy and clean looking. Ham and pineapple pizza rocks and their garlic knots are so yummy.

Food:  The wings and the bloody Mary's ! Best wings in philly.  The north third wing sauce which is just their mild buffalo sauce is perfect. There's so much meat on their wings. 

Environment: It's very laid back. It gets super busy in there but the longest wait is about 15 min.  I love their pretty neat artwork decor as well.

Good place for a dinner with friends, small space but cozy still, quantity is good, recommend four or
Five people eat together to share more variety, since their dish is big, I live the place but the do not like the greasy floor, suggest to have a bigger table and heavier chairs. Room deco is good, service is OK, sometimes you can see the drowsy faces from the servants in the busy days.

This place is "eat off the floor" clean.  I've always enjoyed PDQ.  The food is always hot, fresh and good.  I like the drink machine that allows you to get a custom choice.  Pro tip: go inside.  Grab a table and feast on good chicken sandwiches. PDQ is fast, good and is a real treat.
Cute place. For anyone who loves a good biscuit. Yummy.

The verde sauce is good. Anything with enchilada sauce just tastes like tomato paste, super bland, didn't even want to eat it. We were pretty disappointed. Salsa was mild which I like but again super bland.

I'm not even finished eating and I'm here writing a review. 
I can't believe that we have Indian cuisine of this caliber this close to home. I am beyond impressed. 
My husband and daughter had the Chicken Tikka Masala and I ordered the Tandoori mixed grill. The portions are wonderful. 
Also, this is the best garlic naan I've had in years. 
You have new regulars.

This is one of down town's new secrets that will quickly become a popular hot spot during the Saturday Market.  Yes, I know the location is not directly associated with the Saturday Market, but with the location close the Library and along 8th Street, it will be a happening spot.
  Having been in once before, I decided to take my dad in to try one of their meat pies.  We both ordered their lunch specials, a pie, soda, and side.  I was a little discouraged when people who ordered after us had their drinks delivered to them before we received ours.  We didn't have to wait very long for our meat pies to arrive.
  I ordered the steak and cheese pie and it was served nice and hot.  The pie filling didn't ooze out all over and create a mess, the filling was very well put together and made for easy consuming.  The side salad came in a terra cotta pot and was very tasty.  The metal straws that come with the sodas are a treat!  The way they conduct the cold and help make the drink that much colder to drink is a great touch.
  I still need to come back and try one of the monster $11 milk shakes they have on the menu board.  I can't wait to come back to people watch and enjoy a monster milk shake!

This little place is awesome! We love the Italian ice and the sandwiches. The bread tastes fresh-baked. The Italian ice is refreshing and not too sweet. Even better with vodka added in!! The location is perfect. The service was great. The food options are all delicious. I wish they would open one in Fishers.

Discovered this spot while in New Orleans for Essence Festival and the food was sooo good that we ended up eating there multiple times! The service was a little off and the air wasnt working one night but we stayed and enjoyed the food and service. Im really sad to see that it has closes down but glad that I got the chance to check it out.

Absolutely amazing every time I go. All the food is flavorful and always hot. The deserts are amazing and really good rewarmed ! Most of the time the cashier is really sweet and efficient. Only once did I get a snooty young lady. This is one of my favorite restaurants in town for sure!
Ordered breakfast this morning and it was delicious and fresh. We ordered the Californian and the Malibu. Both were great. We will definitely order again.

Let's start from the top.  Today is day five for this joint. Decor is nice, place is very very loud.  Service is excellent very attentive.  We had a couple beers. Happy hour prices make them worth it. Beer is 7-9 bucks a glass.  Sedona shrimp and pasta and crab cakes.  The crab cakes boasted no filler but they certainly weren't lump crab meat as they were more the consistency of tuna fish.  Very fresh and tasty. Chocolate torte for desert.  Check was $66.00 for two.  Pretty steep for nothing particularly special.

Wow terrible service. Ordered a pizza through Uber eats. It took over an hour and half to deliver. Called multiple times and was given the run around about where the pizza was. Then it was delivered (through Uber eats).  I ordered 4 pizza and two were delivered.  Driver just said "sorry bro". Called Grimaldi's back and was given the run around again.  Unbelievable frustrating. Grimaldi's made no ever to make it right.  I will never order from them again.  The pepperoni wasn't cooked either. Nice job Grimaldi's. "Gerard" was the most unprofessional person I've ever dealt with at a restaurant.

This place was spot on. The fried pickles were up there with the best I've had. Burgers were great - flavorful and unique. They even have a homemade ketchup that has an interesting texture and flavor. Our waitor, Gage, was super attentive and personable.

The Blackened Grouper was very tender & flavorful. The bartenders and young lady were very nice and efficient. 

Although the vibe was more " Florida Backwater" than I expected... the service was good

If I could give ZERO  stars I would... 

This is for the location on  n cray croft... Took over 20 min to get food... And that's after I went up to counter to ask about our food... OMG... Talk about a very unorganized place....  I really think they jumped the gun on opening this location... Looked like everyone needs alot more training... 

Won't be going there anytime soon...
We always have great Cuban coffee at Arco Iris. When my family comes in town from Texas, they always want to go to Arco Iris for their coffee and butter bread. We always enjoy the food!

I came here once with my friends and the food and service were good. I come again with my mom because I recently became vegetarian and I wanted her to try vegan food, and I knew lovin' Spoonfuls was good (well food-wise). Now today 8/24 around 3:30 we went to the lovin' spoonfuls on cambell and grant. Once we entered right away me and my mom felt tension. None of the co workers made eye contact with us, and it wasn't until a waitress approached us and I said table for two and, she responded with ok do you mind waiting, which I questioned because there were literally empty seats all around us. None of them were for two people only, but they could've easily sat us in a four person table, because that is the next logical thing to do.  Then another waiter comes to us and asks us how many people, and I responded with 2, and he said "ok there's a table there," and he pointed to the table. Now with my past experience, waiters and waitresses usually walk you to your table. He did not do that. The man just pointed. So me and my mom awkwardly walk to the table because that felt weird. Later on (it wasn't a long wait) the same guy who pointed gave me and my mom menus and napkins and forks. Me and my mom said thank you while the waiter left. I noticed he did not ask us "would you like to start with a drink?" And my naive self thought "oh maybe he just forgot he'll come back" (lol). Me and my mom are looking at the menu, and as usual I was helping her read the menu since her stronger lang

This place is crazy cool!! The atmosphere is very clean and modern. With games in and around the tables to play while you wait and eat! The staff was very helpful with the menu and offered lots of suggestions. Imagine a waffle dessert, then imagine eating it off a stick. This is that place. We ordered a churros waffle and s'mores waffle (2 for $5?! What a steal). And they were so delicious!! Also had to try their gourmet shakes, which we decided on the leche flan and Cookie Monster. The Cookie Monster shake.... wow. Amazing. Already planning my next trip there because there is so much more I need and want to try!!

Well seasoned, well cooked, clean restaurant, and solid lunch spot.  The finger steak basket was fresh and hot, salt and peppered fries, with really solid fry sauce and homemade barbeque sauce.  The staff was friendly and attentive.  There are a handful of mom and pop burger locations in the area and I'll be back to Main Street Burger!

Ordered food for takeout during the pandemic and because boyfriend wants to support local. It's a local favorite among people in the area and I was visiting from out of state. Drawn to the name of the joint we got take out because there's no sit down available. I was excited to try their sweet potato fries, but it's not good for take out. The bbq burger I ordered was good. We tried to review the fries and onion rings in the oven to no avail. I'm told grumpy's is much better as a sit down. All in all I'd come back for the burgers and give the fries a try again

This place just opened a couple months ago & my dad wanted to try it. It was amazing!! We seriously got our food in like 7 minutes. So fast & great quality. I got the pollo fundido & my dad got the chicken fajitas which is a HUGE portion!! Our server was very welcoming. Will come back.

This is amazing!! My boyfriend and I normally go to Krab Kingz, and this place blows them out of the water. Our server Jennifer was so kind, helpful and very attentive. We will definitely be coming back.

Thanks guys!
Great food and service!   Staff is friendly and helpful.   Had the red curry and some sushi.  Spring rolls wonderful as were the baked mussels.  Will definitely go again!

Ordered from DoorDash. They didn't have one of the cookie last we wanted, the Baja Mac & cheese was good but we asked for a bread bowl and they did not give us one. The piece of bread was just YEETED into the bag.
And the icing on the cake - my bottle of lemonade I ordered is expired. Today is January 9, 2020. YuS lemonade expired December 23, 2019. This expired lemonade had gone unnoticed in their refrigerator for at least two weeks, unacceptable.
My Napa Almond chicken salad sandwich was super tasty though. 

I love Panera Bread and wish to see better from them in the future.
Got a burrito the other day for lunch and it was delicious! The queso was so yummy! The man at the front was very friendly! 5 stars!

OMG!!!! Y'all! I haven't had a brunch that taste this great in a looooooong time! The restaurant is so beautiful and cozy. The food is to die for! There's usually a wait here but I always use the waitlist. Centrally located in the French Quarters. I got the stuffed french toast, cheesy grits, chicken sausage, over easy eggs and the morning mimosa! Everything was awesome! Will be back!
WOW best pasta ever. Princepessa sauce with meatballs and rigatoni was amazing. Will deff be ordering from here again

Easily a match for DC's Eden Center. It was packed at 4pm on a post-lockdown Sunday.

Travelled from Brandon for a tofu banh-mi and taro smoothie with boba. Very fresh ingredients in perfect proportions. I'm full and very satiated.

The bakery has a nice selection of prepared foods.

We'll gladly drive over 40 minutes for this!

The ONLY redeeming service was out server, Marissa, who was as sweet as she could be. She was great at her job! When I walked in, I wasn't greeted for several minutes and when I was FINALLY acknowledged by the hostess who played on her phone for what seemed like forever, looked like Jaclyni or something unique, I already felt unwanted and like she had better things to do than sit my party. Way to welcome us to the restaurant. If it wasn't for Marissa, I'd have left a 1 star review. If I come back, it'll only be because the server made it worth it. The food was subpar and cold, but I could see the server was trying her best. Buffalo Wild Wings is going to the gutter these days hiring whoever they can find off the street... shame. :/ Do better.
So often food is bland but the flavors are amazing. I didn't even need the additional sauces provided. Great for vegans and non vegans.

With options across the board, Joey B's cluttered menu doesn't disappoint. You can play it safe with a delicious salad, gourmet steak, bottomless pasta, or just watch the game with a burger. Setup in two main areas: the bar section w/ tabletops and flat-screens, then a main dining area w/ booths forming the perimeter.

The Chicken Modega, recommended by the server, arrived hot & jam-packed with flavor. Penne pasta complimented the dish splendidly well. Pimientos &. Green Onions in the salad brought things full-circle; Their 1000 Island Dressing had an in-house variation to it. BONUS POINTS! 

***Serves as an ideal moderation between fine dining and the sports fan mentality. Joey B's belongs at the core of its family franchises in the area. Affordable, classy, and filled with friendly people***
Again the order is late!!!! We order around 5pm and the pick up is around 6:30 we waited again like 1hr!!!

If you know Tom , this Restaurant is exactly what you would imagine it to be. Great menu, great servers, and Tom makes sure that you feel at home no matter who you are. This will be our new go to sports restaurant.

One of our favorite spots to ride our bikes to because of the food, great wait staff, and view of the river.  That being said, last weekend we didn't have the best experience.  The hostess (short blond hair) asked, "Two?"  She walked a few feet to the first table at the entrance to the bar and plopped down the menus.  Normal hostess would ask," Is this ok?"  Nope, she just looked away.  I asked," Do we have to sit here?"  It was shortly after opening so most of the tables were open.  She asked," What's wrong with it?"  No kidding.  I told her I understand if she needs to fill a certain server's area, but, just asking.  I explained that we came to this restaurant because of the river view.  Could we sit where we can see it?  The other restaurants on the river don't have a view of the river (and the food is not as good).  She picked up the menus and walked farther down closer to the end of the bar area.  Gosh, sorry to put her out, which was how she acted, dropped the menus, and walked away.  Our server, Jennie, was fabulous as our other servers in the past, personable and kind.  And the manager, whom we have seen buzzing around asking on the food and bussing tables, is great also.  That's just an aside.

Totally recommend for Sunday brunch. Today was our first time for brunch. We - my sis & I, both ordered Chicken & Waffles & spilt the Hot Cakes for the kids. The only reason this is 4 stars is they didn't have coffee at all. I had to walk down the block to get some, but the service from everyone was so top notch! We'll be back for more delicious food & we'll hope they have coffee next time!

Chai Yo Staff:  Your fried rice used to be our favorite.   We ordered it today and it was NOT good, PLEASE correct this.   There is no flavor, no ingredients really to speak of besides rice and chicken....   There used to be so much flavor on this dish...   Very disappointed.
